admission.justification: The shared batch spans the adapter and the extracted reader, and prevents duplicate refreshes and a stale stamped entry from undoing a newer periodic verdict.

applicability: Every tick that has at least one new stamped end or one due report.
conditions: One bridge process per tick receives both the stamped agents and the ordered seat candidates of each due report.
A forced refresh result is shared by every seat that names the report.
A successful periodic verdict beats a stamped-only cached entry for the same report.
exclusions: A stamped-only seat with no forced refresh keeps its cached read.
A failed or empty result never erases a fact or a mapping.
statement: A tick combines its stamped and periodic triggers in one bridge process and shares the forced result for each report.
